heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles Overture PLA Professional effortlessly right out of the box, sustaining safe maximum print speeds up to 250 mm/s at a 21 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. Because this modified PLA blend does not require a hardened nozzle, simply leave the top glass vented or the front door unlatched during long print runs to avoid heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Bambu Textured PEI Plate without adhesive (clean with dish soap and warm water)
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 21 mm³/s in the Filament Settings to prevent under-extrusion at high-speed infill moves.
Enable Pressure Advance (K-factor) calibration and start with a baseline value of 0.024 tuned for direct drive.
Set Print Temperature to 215³C for high-speed printing above 200 mm/s to ensure adequate thermal transfer in the stainless steel hotend.
Configure Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan to 60-70% for steep overhangs and bridging, but drop chamber exhaust to prevent ambient drafts.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and mid-print jam (Heat Creep)
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Enclosed chamber air temperature rising above 35³C, softening PLA filament prematurely in the direct-drive extruder gears.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Prop the top glass panel open using printed risers or crack the front door open 10-20mm during printing.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner lifting and warping on large flat models
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Auxiliary cooling fan blowing unidirectional cold air aggressively across the lower print layers.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Reduce the auxiliary cooling fan speed to 0-30% for the initial 20 layers and set bed temperature to 60³C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine wispy stringing during travel moves across perimeters
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Nozzle temperature slightly too high for detailed low-flow moves combined with inactive wipe settings.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Enable 'Wipe while retracting' (set to 2mm) and reduce printing temperature to 205³C-210³C for intricate geometries.

faq.question: Do I need to leave the Bambu Lab P1S door open when printing Overture PLA Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, it is highly recommended to tilt open the top glass cover or crack the front door open, as PLA Pro has a relatively low glass transition temperature (~55-60³C) that makes it prone to heat creep clogging in a fully sealed chamber.

faq.question: Can the stock stainless steel nozzle handle Overture PLA Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, Overture PLA Professional is a non-abrasive blend that uses impact modifiers rather than carbon fiber or glow pigments, meaning the stock stainless steel nozzle on the P1S will not experience accelerated wear.

faq.question: What max volumetric flow rate should I set in OrcaSlicer for this filament?
faq.answer: Set the filament profile maximum volumetric speed to 21 mm³/s, which allows the P1S to comfortably reach standard linear speeds of 250 mm/s at a 0.2mm layer height and 0.42mm line width.

faq.question: Is glue stick necessary on the Bambu Textured PEI plate for Overture PLA Pro?
faq.answer: No, glue stick is unnecessary. Overture PLA Pro adheres strongly to clean textured PEI at 55-60³C and releases freely once the build plate cools below 35³C.
